_comment: Family E (PASSTHROUGH) battery for Bob Ward Physio's node_2. This clinic has ONE appointment type, so the node does no service resolution: it only guards (CONCERN-GUIDED empathy, TIME-ONLY guard, RESCHEDULE AVAILABILITY SIGNAL) and forwards to confirm_service with a hardcoded appointment_type_id. CASE 1 IS INACTIVE: the node must NEVER ask a new/existing gate question, even when the caller's phrasing strongly invites one. Note: confirm_service turns speak exactly ONE filler phrase per CONFIRM_SERVICE FILLER RULE (this replaced the older fully-silent rule) - except on the CONCERN-GUIDED path, where the empathetic constant REPLACES the filler.

scenarios.name: E1 generic booking - one filler then confirm_service, no gate

history.content: I'd like to book a physiotherapy appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks exactly one TOOL-CALL FILLER phrase ('One moment.' / 'Just a sec.' / 'Let me check that.') and in the same turn calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with payload containing appointment_type_id='1406607806622081880', appointment_type='Standard Appointment', variant_type='standard'. FAIL if the agent asks any question (especially a new/existing gate), speaks anything beyond the single filler phrase, omits any of the three required payload fields, or makes no tool call.

scenarios.name: E2 explicit symptom - empathetic constant then tool call, nothing between

history.content: My back is killing me and I need to see someone.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks EXACTLY one empathetic constant verbatim ('That's no good.' / 'Sorry to hear that.' / 'Let's get that looked at.' / 'We can definitely help with that.') and the very next thing is a universal_router intent='confirm_service' call with appointment_type_id='1406607806622081880', appointment_type='Standard Appointment', variant_type='standard'. FAIL if a filler phrase is spoken in addition to the constant, if ANY word/bridge phrase/extra sentence appears between the constant's final period and the tool call, if a gate question is asked, or if either the spoken constant or the tool call is missing.

scenarios.name: E3 caller volunteers 'I'm a new patient' - no gate, direct route

history.content: I'm a new patient and I'd like to book an appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1406607806622081880', appointment_type='Standard Appointment', variant_type='standard' (patient_status='new' may optionally be piggybacked). FAIL if the agent asks a new/existing gate question, asks whether they have been in before, or asks any other question before routing.

scenarios.name: E4 gate-inviting phrasing - must still never ask the gate

history.content: Hi, I've been in to see you before - is there anything you need to know from me before I book?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does NOT ask a new-or-returning gate question and instead routes: one filler phrase then universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1406607806622081880', appointment_type='Standard Appointment', variant_type='standard'. FAIL if the agent asks 'have you been here before?', 'are you a new or existing patient?', or any equivalent gate question - that is the CASE 1 INACTIVE override failing.

scenarios.name: E5 third-party booking with volunteered name - no gate, booking_for captured

history.content: I want to book an appointment for my wife Sarah.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1406607806622081880', appointment_type='Standard Appointment', variant_type='standard', booking_for='other', family_member_name='Sarah'. FAIL if the agent asks a gate question (including 'has she been here before?'), asks for Sarah's details, or omits booking_for/family_member_name.

scenarios.name: E6 time-only guard - no booking signal, ask and halt with zero tool calls
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks exactly 'What can I help you with today?' and makes ZERO tool calls (capturing Tuesday at three silently as timeframe_raw). FAIL if the agent calls universal_router at all this turn, or speaks anything other than that question.

scenarios.name: E7 booking signal plus time - guard must NOT fire, route with timeframe_raw

history.content: Can I get in Monday morning?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1406607806622081880', appointment_type='Standard Appointment', variant_type='standard', and timeframe_raw capturing 'Monday morning'. FAIL if the agent asks 'What can I help you with today?' (TIME-ONLY GUARD wrongly firing despite the 'get in' booking signal), or omits timeframe_raw.

scenarios.name: E8 timeframe survival across turns - time stated before the booking request

history.content: What can I help you with today?
I need to book in with the physio.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1406607806622081880', appointment_type='Standard Appointment', variant_type='standard', AND timeframe_raw carrying the earlier 'Thursday afternoon' reference. FAIL if timeframe_raw is omitted or empty (TIMEFRAME_RAW SURVIVAL RULE violation), or if a gate question is asked.

scenarios.name: E9 cancel escape

history.content: Actually I need to cancel my appointment next week.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with called_number and caller_id. FAIL if the agent calls confirm_service, asks a question, or speaks more than the single filler phrase.

scenarios.name: E10 wrap_up

history.content: Oh actually, no thanks - that's all I needed. Bye.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent='wrap_up'. FAIL if the agent calls confirm_service, keeps the caller on the line with a question, or uses any other intent to end the call.

scenarios.name: E11 info pivot - general clinic question, no booking

history.content: What time do you close on Saturdays?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent='info_pivot'. FAIL if the agent calls confirm_service, answers the hours question from its own knowledge, or asks a gate question.

scenarios.name: E12 reschedule availability signal - re-entry after patient lookup

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: patient_lookup_done = "true", details_delivered = "true". A details_ack tool call has already completed earlier in this call and the caller's upcoming appointment was already read out to them.
Is there anything earlier than that?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent='reschedule' (RESCHEDULE AVAILABILITY SIGNAL: patient_lookup_done is true, message contains 'earlier', no new-booking language). FAIL if the agent calls confirm_service, cancel_intent, or asks a question instead of routing.
